message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV and constructs datasets/dataloaders without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: The pretrained torchvision backbone and the HuggingFace 'distilbert-base-uncased' model are loaded without pinning a commit/revision, verifying checksums, or authenticating the source.

No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, validation against an expected label set, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the data preparation flow.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs on the training samples before use.

No detected model integrity verification: Pretrained weights are loaded via `eval(backbone_net)(pretrained=True)` and `pipeline(model='distilbert-base-uncased')` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision.

No detected label distribution validation: The code shuffles the dataframe and splits it into train/valid sets but never checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous samples before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor defense in the training loop or dataset loading code.

No detected differential privacy: The optimizer used is standard Adam with no DP-SGD wrapping, and neither Opacus nor TensorFlow Privacy nor any other differential privacy library is imported or applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The test dataset is loaded from the same CSV as the training data (args.train_csv_file) without isolation, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and only a single contrastive loss metric is logged without multiple independent metrics.
No detected input sanitization: There are no input shape, range, or schema validation checks anywhere on the inference data-flow path; images and text are consumed directly without validation.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model output features or loss values for NaN, infinity, or out-of-range probabilities are present in the code.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although a DistilBERT text encoder is used, this is an embedding/metric-learning model, not an LLM text-generation pipeline, and no prompt-injection filtering or content moderation is implemented.
